LanguageData.BOR_QuantumRebreatherMask.label: quantum rebreather mask
LanguageData.BOR_QuantumRebreatherMask.description: A filtered quantum rebreather built for hazardous substrate work. The mask stabilizes breathing feedback and keeps the wearer steady in environments where fine pressure control matters more than raw armor.
LanguageData.BOR_Sunforge_Calibration_Visor.label: sunforge calibration visor
LanguageData.BOR_Sunforge_Calibration_Visor.descripti: A narrow visor that filters glare and timing drift for precision forging. It is tuned to keep the wearer visually locked onto heat gradients, seams, and microscopic alignment cues.
LanguageData.BOR_Quantum_Haptic_Gloves.label: quantum haptic gloves
LanguageData.BOR_Quantum_Haptic_Gloves.description: Fine haptic gloves tuned for microscopic substrate handling. They translate tactile feedback into stable, deliberate motion without relying on item quality to do the work.
LanguageData.BOR_Precision_Assembly_Gloves.label: precision assembly gloves
LanguageData.BOR_Precision_Assembly_Gloves.descriptio: Structured sensor gloves with haptic sub-dermal guides. They reward careful hands and steady pressure with a quality-dependent boost to assembly speed.
